purpose: Register current Spain-regulated deployments of IGT titles with independently documented variable/persistent-state advantage-play mechanics, while refusing to transfer foreign state semantics, thresholds, RTPs or paytables into Spain without an exact configuration fingerprint.

persistentMechanismEvidence.onlineRulesFact: bubble positions on the reels are persistent per bet level

advantagePlayEvidence.documentedPrinciple: A player advantage can exist when a prior player leaves wild bubbles in favorable positions; play/pass depends on the visible next-spin bubble state.
advantagePlayEvidence.historicalOnlineExploitFact: New Jersey online casinos were reportedly beaten for about USD900k when Ocean Magic launched in a favorable repeated initial bubble state.

spainStateSemantics.note: These are the decisive Spain-specific gates. Foreign IGT rules prove the title family can be persistent online, not that EnRacha exposes the same state scope.

identityEvidence.primaryIgtFact: IGT describes Regal Riches as persistent state gaming.
identityEvidence.wizardProviderFact: Wizard of Odds identifies Regal Riches/Prosperity Pearl as Unity, a division/subsidiary of IGT.

persistentMechanismEvidence.wizardFact: banked wilds can make a left-behind visible state favorable; each bet level has separate banks
persistentMechanismEvidence.reasonThresholdsNotTransferred: Wizard explicitly labels the entry numbers as approximate advice based on AP opinions, and EnRacha's exact RTP/configuration/state scope has not been fingerprinted.

portfolioFinding.whatThisProves: The Spain-regulated online lobby currently contains exact titles belonging to globally documented persistent/variable-state advantage-play families.
portfolioFinding.whatThisDoesNotProve: It does not prove that the Spanish online wrappers preserve cross-player state or that any currently visible state is positive EV.

nextEvidenceTargets: Recover EnRacha in-game rules/help for Ocean Magic without placing a wager and compare the complete rule fingerprint to the IGT online persistent-per-bet-level rules.
Recover EnRacha in-game rules/help for Regal Riches without placing a wager and verify meter names, reset values, caps, payout semantics and RTP/configuration.
Determine by public documentation or zero-bet passive observation whether state persists across logout/reload and, critically, across different players rather than being account-private.
If and only if exact Spain configuration equivalence is proven, build a configuration-specific state EV solver and freeze a prospective validation protocol before any economic promotion.
